statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low because Monday’s cash session demonstrated substantial mean reversion; verified sources do not yet provide sufficiently current post-reopen NQ path detail to establish persistent extension.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The next material checkpoint is Tuesday’s 12:30 UTC Empire State release followed by the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open, with re-escalation conditional on observed one-way extension and failed retracements.
headline: Tail remains low after Monday mean reversion; Tuesday data/open sequence is the next path checkpoint
body: The Nasdaq closed 0.56% lower after recovering substantially from deeper opening weakness before a late second leg. The PHLX semiconductor index fell 5.9%, the 10-year Treasury yield briefly exceeded 5%, and Brent settled at $105.68. Fresh verified post-reopen NQ path evidence is insufficient to classify the current hour as persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock hours, Tail rose from WATCH into elevated overnight and through the U.S. open, peaking at 32%, then fell as Monday produced substantial intraday mean reversion. A late second leg briefly returned Tail to WATCH at 20:00 UTC before the 21:00 UTC assessment moved back to low.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because Monday demonstrated retracement capacity and fresh post-reopen NQ persistence is not yet verified. Conditional risk rises into Tuesday’s 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, peaking at 24% WATCH unless observed failed retracements justify a higher path-risk state.
